create_memory_entry: create a new memory entry with a key, value, and optional metadata via POST /v1/memory
list_memory_entries: list memory entries visible to the caller with optional key prefix filter and pagination via GET /v1/memory
get_memory_by_key: get a single memory entry by its key scoped to the caller via GET /v1/memory/{key}
upsert_memory_entry: upsert a memory entry by key updating value or metadata or creating if missing via PUT /v1/memory/{key}
delete_memory_entry: delete a memory entry by key after verifying write access via DELETE /v1/memory/{key}
